title: Introduce FlowSmith RAG Lab & Typed Contract Starter (beta)
author: Priya Nambiar
description: Motivation: teams repeatedly ask for a compact, opinionated authoring sandbox that pairs a minimal RAG playbook with typed tool/contract examples and lightweight telemetry presets. FlowSmith RAG Lab is a curated quickstart that demonstrates: 1) schema-first typed tool contracts (OpenAPI/JSON Schema snippets and TS bindings), 2) a minimal authoring loop with a hot-reload dev server, 3) a compact telemetry preset so teams see token/response traces and step-level success metrics out of the box. This PR adds the starter under quickstarts/flowsmith-lab and includes a generator for typed adapters, a minimal indexer mock, and examples showing common failure modes (rate-limit fallbacks, partial indexing). Checklist: - [x] Add quickstart README and guided walkthrough - [x] Add typed-contract generator (ts) and example contracts - [x] Add dev server with hot reload and mock indexer - [x] Add telemetry presets and sample probes - [x] Add CI smoke job for quickstart boot - [x] Add short tutorial notebook linking to docs site Implementation notes: the quickstart is intentionally minimal: the bundle includes a small Node/TS dev server that emulates a tool registry and an in-memory indexer so users can iterate without infra. Typed-contract generator emits a small set of TS bindings (README documents usage). Telemetry presets are lightweight JSON files that the dev server reads and emits to stdout; they are intentionally non-blocking. Backwards compatibility: none of the platform APIs are changed; this is an authoring-only artifact. Follow-ups: if we see traction, we'll promote to a full example with a real connector and expand telemetry mapping to match Console trace schemas (ENG-1499).
